title: Suspend a graph for durable human approval
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `approval_interrupt` to suspend for durable human approval then resume with an actor provenance stamp.
implementation: `suspend_for_approval` / `resume_approval` via product verb `approval_interrupt`. Maps to durable advice/approval yields when hosts compose it into graphs later.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `approval_interrupt_cycle.yaml` drives `approval_interrupt`; expects pending → approved with actor provenance.
